info.title: arXiv public API (yorishiro kami spec)
info.description:
Hand-authored OpenAPI 3 spec for arXiv's public query API. arXiv does not publish an OpenAPI document — this file is the etzhayyim-side canonical representation of the kami's surface and is used as input to `yorishiro create arxiv --from openapi-v3`.

Reference: https://info.arxiv.org/help/api/user-manual.html

get.description: Search arXiv for papers matching a structured query. Returns an Atom 1.0 feed. Either `searchQuery` or `idList` (or both) must be supplied. The Atom XML is returned verbatim — parsing belongs to the caller cell.

parameters.name: search_query
parameters.description: arXiv structured query (e.g. `cat:cs.AI AND ti:transformer`). At least one of `search_query` or `id_list` must be present.

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: Page size. arXiv caps this near 2000; the public API recommends ≤100 per call.

200.description: Atom 1.0 feed of matching arXiv entries.

schema.description: Atom XML body. Pass to a feed parser (e.g. feedparser) downstream.
